topic: A ball rolls under the sofa; Bruno is too big, so small Mishi saves the day. Being small is a superpower.

episode.title: Mishi’s Small Superpower

shots.narration: Their favorite ball vanished right beneath Bruno’s nose!
shots.scene: Cosy colourful living room, rounded yellow sofa, soft warm lighting, 3D family animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: A bright red ball rolls beneath the sofa directly in front of Bruno’s big black nose.
shots.mood: Playful surprise, wide puppy eyes, bright red ball against a cream rug.

shots.narration: Bruno knew exactly where to look.
shots.scene: Floor beside the yellow sofa, narrow shadowed gap underneath, warm sunlight, 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno lowers his head to peer beneath the sofa.
shots.mood: Curious golden-brown puppy, floppy ears spread beside his blue collar.

shots.narration: [chuckles] But his big paw couldn't reach!
shots.scene: Floor-level view beneath the rounded sofa, red ball beyond reach, 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno stretches one broad paw toward the distant red ball.
shots.mood: Gentle comic frustration, paw visibly short of the ball.

shots.narration: Mishi came closer to inspect the tiny gap.
shots.scene: Cream rug beside the yellow sofa, Bruno resting nearby, warm living room, 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi crouches beside the sofa gap.
shots.mood: Thoughtful grey kitten, alert green eyes, little red ear bow.

shots.narration: Her little paw fit perfectly underneath.
shots.scene: Close floor-level view of the sofa gap and cream rug, 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi slips one small grey paw beneath the sofa.
shots.mood: Quiet discovery, tiny paw framed against the roomy gap.

shots.scene: Beneath the sofa edge, red ball visible near a rounded wooden leg, 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi reaches her small paw around the back of the ball.
shots.mood: Focused anticipation, soft sunlight illuminating grey fur and red rubber.

shots.narration: One careful nudge brought the ball into view.
shots.scene: Sofa edge above the cream rug, red ball partly beneath it, 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi nudges the red ball toward the sofa opening.
shots.mood: Careful progress, bright ball emerging into warm light.

shots.narration: Bruno waited beside the opening, ready to help.
shots.scene: Living room floor beside the sofa opening, Mishi crouched nearby, 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno plants his broad paw just beyond the emerging ball.
shots.mood: Eager teamwork, attentive puppy and focused kitten.

shots.narration: [giggles] His big paw made the perfect ball stop!
shots.scene: Cream rug directly outside the yellow sofa, warm sunlight, 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: The red ball rolls out against Bruno’s waiting paw.
shots.mood: Cheerful success, rescued ball safely between the friends.

shots.narration: Bruno rolled their rescued treasure back to Mishi.
shots.scene: Open cream rug beside the rounded yellow sofa, 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Bruno gently rolls the red ball toward Mishi.
shots.mood: Affectionate play, relaxed puppy ears and bright kitten eyes.

shots.narration: Then something rustled beyond the garden door.
shots.scene: Living room facing an open garden doorway, leafy shrub outside, red ball on rug, 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: A leafy garden shrub gently trembles beyond the doorway.
shots.mood: Sunny curiosity, friends watching the softly moving leaves.

shots.narration: [excited] Small is a superpower! Next: the garden rustle!
shots.scene: Sunny garden threshold opening onto flowers and a leafy shrub, 3D animation, vertical 9:16, no text.
shots.action: Mishi and Bruno step together toward the garden.
shots.mood: Confident friendship, warm sunshine, inviting green garden.

episode.endHook: Next time, a mysterious rustle waits in the garden!
episode.description: When their ball rolls under the sofa, Bruno’s paws cannot reach it! Little Mishi finds a clever way to help, showing that being small can be a superpower.
